This will cause `None` to be returned, breaking the comparison on line 637. ```python def _get_asset_check_partition_status(self, key: AssetCheckKey, partition: str, from_subset: EntitySubset) -> "AssetCheckExecutionResolvedStatus": record = self.instance.event_log_storage.get_latest_asset_check_execution_by_key(key, partition) # Missing: return statement with resolved status ``` ```suggestion def _get_asset_check_partition_status(self, key: AssetCheckKey, partition: str, from_subset: EntitySubset) -> "AssetCheckExecutionResolvedStatus": record = self.instance.event_log_storage.get_latest_asset_check_execution_by_key(key, partition) if record is None: return AssetCheckExecutionResolvedStatus.NOT_EXECUTED return AssetCheckExecutionResolvedStatus.from_execution_record(record) ``` *Spotted by [Graphite Agent](https://app.graphite.com/diamond/?org=dagster-io&ref=ai-review-comment)*



Is this helpful? React 👍 or 👎 to let us know.

Variable name mismatch and argument count error. Line 637 uses `pk` in the list comprehension but then references undefined variable `ap` in the condition.
